newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: EU foreign ministers urge ceasefire in east Zaire.
newsitem.headline: EU foreign ministers urge ceasefire in east Zaire.

text.p: European Union foreign ministers called on Monday for an immediate ceasefire in eastern Zaire, where it said millions of lives were threatened.
Irish Foreign Minister Dick Spring, representing the current EU presidency, said "a humanitarian catastrophe" could result unless all sides showed restraint.
"The situation is disastrous," he told a news conference after a meeting of the 15-nation bloc's foreign ministers. "We are looking at a disastrous humanitarian crisis."
But Spring ruled out any EU military response to the crisis, saying there had been no discussions on sending forces to the area.
